evaluation_note: The signal and threshold were selected and scored on the same 148 detector-supported labelled images out of 150 hand-tagged images. The 2 images without detector signal (media IDs 271 and 375; one profile-positive, one profile-negative) are reported as a separate stratum and excluded from signal/threshold metrics. These are calibration-sample metrics, not held-out performance estimates.

labelled_image_accounting.policy: Images without detector signal are excluded from profile signal/threshold metrics and reported as a separate stratum; they are not treated as profile-negative.
